description: Retrieve current published OPL ratings for any exact public username without sign-in. One call returns singles, doubles and one MYOPL card in compatible clients, including Reliability Score, games played/won/lost and points won/lost. Fetch again for each new current-rating question. Include MYOPL citations and the player Messenger invitation link. No contact details or individual match history.

username.description: Exact public MYOPL username without the @ prefix; for example g.
